2607.25956.title: Large Language Model for Operations Research Formulation Selection in Multi-Warehouse Inventory Allocation
2607.25956.paper_summary: Multi-warehouse inventory allocation is typically formulated as a mixed-integer programming (MIP) problem, yet no single formulation consistently matches heterogeneous instance-level regimes induced by demand concentration, inventory imbalance, replenishment scale, service constraints, and forecast volatility. We study this issue as instance-wise operations research (OR) formulation selection, where each allocation instance is assigned to a solver-executable formulation from a candidate OR expert library. We propose a solver-guided large language model (LLM) framework for OR formulation selection, in which each OR expert corresponds to a MIP formulation encoding a distinct allocation priority. To train the selector, the framework first constructs balanced expert-conditioned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) records for schema learning, and then uses MIP solver evaluation on historical instances to convert solver-evaluated allocation-quality gaps into margin-weighted identity preference optimization (IPO) preferences and per-instance expert-score metadata for reward lookup during group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to assign rewards to sampled responses. Experiments on multi-warehouse inventory allocation instances from JD$\mathord{.}$com, one of China's largest e-retailers, demonstrate that GRPO substantially improves expert-selection accuracy relative to the SFT+IPO selector and, more importantly, produces higher realized allocation quality than both the preference-trained selector and the best fixed formulation. With GRPO, Hit Ratio@1 and Hit Ratio@2 increase from 21.45% to 50.42% and from 70.47% to 82.31%. The resulting selector achieves an allocation accuracy gain of 12.57 percentage points over the incumbent baseline, outperforming both the SFT+IPO selector and the best fixed OR expert, and reduces the gap to the ex-post oracle to 4.85 percentage points.
2607.25956.paper_summary_zh: 多倉庫庫存分配通常被表述為一個混合整數規劃（MIP）問題，但沒有單一的表述能夠持續匹配由需求集中、庫存不平衡、補貨規模、服務限制和預測波動所引起的異質實例級別模式。我們將這個問題視為實例級運籌學（OR）表述選擇，其中每個分配實例被分配到候選OR專家庫中的一個可執行表述。我們提出了一個由求解器引導的大型語言模型（LLM）框架，用於OR表述選擇，其中每個OR專家對應於編碼不同分配優先級的MIP表述。為了訓練選擇器，該框架首先構建平衡的專家條件監督微調（SFT）記錄以進行模式學習，然後利用歷史實例上的MIP求解器評估將求解器評估的分配質量差距轉換為邊際加權身份偏好優化（IPO）偏好和每個實例的專家分數元數據，以便在群體相對政策優化（GRPO）期間查找獎勵，從而將獎勵分配給抽樣的回應。在來自中國最大的電子零售商之一JD.com的多倉庫庫存分配實例上的實驗表明，GRPO相較於SFT+IPO選擇器顯著提高了專家選擇的準確性，更重要的是，實現了比偏好訓練選擇器和最佳固定表述更高的分配質量。使用GRPO，Hit Ratio@1和Hit Ratio@2從21.45%提高到50.42%，從70.47%提高到82.31%。最終的選擇器在分配準確性上比現有基準提高了12.57個百分點，超越了SFT+IPO選擇器和最佳固定OR專家，並將與事後oracle的差距縮小至4.85個百分點。
